items.title: Juntaba propinas siendo mago en Plaza Serrano y hoy es reconocido en el mundo
items.identity_evidence: Names Ezequiel Escudero as a technological genius who joined in 2014, and was later incorporated as a partner.
items.supported_claim: Ezequiel Escudero provided a notable technological impulse to their shows, 'making true miracles on stage'.
items.evidence_locator: Section 'Un paso más allá de la magia'
items.conflict_note: Timeline states Ezequiel Escudero was met in 2014 and incorporated as a partner later, which conflicts with other catalog articles stating they created the company in 2012 together.
